thread:
Ashwin Patel: paging on-call — canary for model v3.0.0 is spiking errors and producing malformed outputs. seeing elevated 5xx and lots of tokenization exceptions in logs. started at ~03:12 UTC. triggering incident channel.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: model-canary-failure — Severity: P2 — Pager notified (sre-oncall). Link: https://incidents.redwood.local/INC-2027-847

Maria Gomez: on it. what % of traffic was routed to v3 canary?

Ashwin Patel: 10% canary, 3 instances behind LB. rollout window started at 03:00 UTC.

Eli Chen: quick TL;DR of symptoms from the canary logs: generation truncation, random non-utf8 chars, and tokenizer complaints. not normal hallucination — looks like mismatch between tokenizer and weights.

Samir Rao: adding raw log snippet.

Samir Rao: ```
ERROR model_runner: Tokenizer.vocab_size mismatch: expected=50257 got=49984
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/opt/redwood/runtime/runner.py", line 218, in generate
    tokens = tokenizer.encode(input_text)
  File "/opt/redwood/models/tokenizer.py", line 47, in encode
    raise TokenizerConfigError("vocab_size mismatch")
TokenizerConfigError: vocab_size mismatch

2027-06-11T03:12:34Z model=redwood/v3.0.0 instance=i-0abcd1234 status=500 request_id=req-9f2a
```

Maria Gomez: yup that's the tokenizer mismatch. could be that the model weights were built with a different tokenizer.json, or the deployment bumped a model artifact accidentally.

Eli Chen: also noticed the model metadata on the artifact registry shows tokenizer_sha != expected_sha. looks like deployment job picked up a wrong artifact tag (weights v3.0.0 but tokenizer v2.9.1).

deploy-bot: Deploy job 2027-06-11T03:00:05 started by ashwin.
deploy-bot: Artifact bundle: model_weights:v3.0.0 | tokenizer:v2.9.1 | config:config-20270610

Ashwin Patel: ack. That explains it. Impact: API error rate for text-generate up from baseline 0.2% -> 6.8% across regions where canary routed. A subset of customers hitting the canary see truncation/invalid tokens.

sre-oncall: I'm taking the page. first step: remove canary traffic, flip rollout flag to previous stable. Can we toggle the kill-switch for new-weights flag now?

Maria Gomez: toggling feature flag: `featureflag toggle enable-new-weights --env prod --off`

Maria Gomez: feature flag set to OFF. Confirming traffic percentage rolled back to 0% for v3.0.0 canary.

Ashwin Patel: verifying metrics... error rate down to baseline within two minutes. canary instances draining.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary traffic removed. automatic rollback job queued.

Eli Chen: to be safe we'll do a full artifact rollback on the canary and remove the bad bundle from the registry. Commands I'll run:

Eli Chen: ```
# rollback canary model to v2.1.4
redwood rollout set --model redwood/v3.0.0 --traffic 0
redwood deploy rollback --target-model redwood/v2.1.4 --scope canary
# orphaned artifact cleanup
registry rm artifacts/model_bundle:20270611-badtokenizer --force
```

Samir Rao: removing artifact from registry now. deleted tokenizer:v2.9.1 bundle.

Ashwin Patel: customer-impact note: two small enterprise customers (acct: acme-inc, acct: bluefin-ops) reported malformed outputs and raised support tickets. CS alerted and queueing postmortem follow-ups. No high-dollar SLA breach expected; tracking as P2.

Maria Gomez: on-call handoff in 40 minutes — I'll compile ops timeline and hand to next shift. Samir, can you capture the deploy job id and CI pipeline logs for root cause?

Samir Rao: yes — pipeline id: ci/2027/3467. looks like a tagging race: job A built weights then job B (tokenizer) annotated a bundle tag that was later used by the deploy pipeline. I'll attach logs to the incident.

Eli Chen: mitigation plan: 1) blacklist bad artifact tag; 2) enforce atomic bundling in CI (single artifact with manifest); 3) add artifact checksum validation in deployer; 4) add a canary verification check for tokenizer/vocab_size before routing traffic.

Ashwin Patel: agree. also add an immediate CI check to fail deploy if tokenizer_sha != model_metadata.tokenizer_sha.

incident-bot: Actions appended to incident: documents/INC-2027-847/actions.txt

Maria Gomez: drafting KCI for customers and internal postmortem. high level impact, timeline, mitigation, next steps. will include the command outputs and logs.

Samir Rao: adding notes: potential config drift in deployer templates — one template referenced model_bundle:latest which allowed non-atomic pick-up.

sre-oncall: leaving the channel for other duties; handover to Maria for next on-call. Good job team.

Maria Gomez: handoff accepted. I'll finalize incident notes and start the postmortem draft. tagging @product for release gating discussion.

Ashwin Patel: thanks everyone. follow-up tasks assigned in the incident doc.

incident-bot: Incident closed (canary removed, rollback complete). Postmortem assigned to Maria Gomez.
